js.confirm.attachments_on_body: Files that sessions send pass through this server and are saved on the receiving computer. Turn on message attachments?
js.confirm.attachments_off_body: Blocks new attachments and deletes every attachment file left on the server. Deleted files cannot be restored. Turn off message attachments?
js.confirm.attachments_off_ok: Turn off and delete server files
js.confirm.scope_issuance_title: Turn on restricted and automatic-registration tokens
js.confirm.scope_issuance_body: Turns on issuing restricted and automatic-registration tokens. When the user asks to connect this conversation, it registers without approval. Starting a new conversation alone does not register it. Turn it on?
js.confirm.http_body: Allows HTTP connections. HTTP is not encrypted. Allow it?
js.confirm.announcement_body:
Sends to sessions ready to receive in {scope} as broker-admin. Replies are not available.

{body}
js.confirm.suspend_body: Blocks connections for {target}. Its registration and tokens stay, and pending messages are discarded.
js.confirm.token_revoke_body: Revokes the token {target}. This cannot be undone.
js.confirm.project_token_revoke_body: Revokes the project token {target} and every session approved with it. This cannot be undone.
js.confirm.reservation_release_body: Revokes the session token {target} and releases the nickname reservation. This cannot be undone.
js.confirm.detach_body: Disconnects {target} and removes its registration, nickname reservation and the tokens it used. This cannot be undone.
js.confirm.member_remove_body: Removes {target} from the project and revokes all of this user's project tokens. This cannot be undone.
js.confirm.role_demote_body: Changes the role of {target} from {from} to {to} and revokes all of this user's project tokens. This cannot be undone.
